questions.q: Who was announced as the winner of the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize in October 2026?
questions.e: The Norwegian Nobel Committee named Navanethem (Navi) Pillay, a South African jurist and former UN human rights chief, on 9 October 2026. Mohammadi, Machado and Muratov won in earlier years.

questions.q: Who won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature, announced on 8 October 2026?
questions.e: The Swedish Academy honoured Anne Carson, a Canadian poet, essayist and translator, known for her playful dialogue with the classical tradition. Han Kang and Krasznahorkai won in earlier years.

questions.q: Which film won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards held on 15 March 2026?
questions.e: One Battle After Another won Best Picture, and Paul Thomas Anderson took Best Director for it. Sinners and Hamnet won acting awards, while Sentimental Value won International Feature.

questions.q: Which team won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026, whose final was played on 8 March 2026?
questions.e: India beat New Zealand by 96 runs in the final, retaining the title they won in 2024.

questions.q: Which country won the FIFA World Cup 2026, whose final was played on 19 July 2026?
questions.e: Spain beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the final in New Jersey (the New York New Jersey Stadium).

questions.q: Which franchise won the IPL 2026 title in the final played in late May 2026?
questions.e: Royal Challengers Bengaluru beat Gujarat Titans by 5 wickets to win back-to-back titles.

questions.q: The 60th Jnanpith Award, announced in March 2026 for the year 2025, was given to which writer?
questions.e: R. Vairamuthu, the Tamil poet and lyricist, was named the 60th laureate. Vinod Kumar Shukla (59th) and Gulzar (58th) were honoured in the two preceding cycles.

questions.q: Which novel won the 2025 Booker Prize, announced in London on 10 November 2025?
questions.e: David Szalay won for Flesh. The other three titles were also on the six-book shortlist.

questions.q: On 7 October 2026, the RBI Monetary Policy Committee set the policy repo rate at what level?
questions.e: The MPC raised the repo rate by 25 basis points from 5.25% to 5.50% on 7 October 2026.

questions.q: As of November 2026, who is the Chief Justice of India, having taken oath on 24 November 2025 as the 53rd CJI?
questions.e: Justice Surya Kant succeeded Justice B. R. Gavai and is due to retire in February 2027 on turning 65.

questions.q: In December 2025 the VB-G RAM G Act received Presidential assent. Which earlier law did it replace?
o: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act, 2005
questions.e: The new Act replaces MGNREGA and promises at least 125 days of rural wage employment a year, against 100 days earlier.

questions.q: Which team won the ICC Women's Cricket World Cup 2025, whose final was held in Navi Mumbai in early November 2025?
questions.e: India beat South Africa by 52 runs at DY Patil Stadium to win their first Women's World Cup title.

questions.q: Which film actor was among the posthumous Padma Vibhushan awardees in the Padma Awards 2026, announced on 25 January 2026?
questions.e: Dharmendra received the Padma Vibhushan posthumously. Mammootty was named for the Padma Bhushan.

questions.q: Which country hosted the 2026 Asian Games, held from September to October 2026?
questions.e: The Games were held in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. China hosted the previous edition at Hangzhou in 2023.

questions.q: Which country held the BRICS chairship in 2026 and hosted the 18th BRICS summit in September 2026?
questions.e: India took over the chair from Brazil on 1 January 2026 and hosted the summit in New Delhi on 12-13 September 2026.

questions.q: The 2026 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences, announced on 12 October 2026, was awarded to which pair?
o: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford
questions.e: Hall (Stanford) and Woodford (Columbia) were honoured for microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation. Acemoglu and Johnson were 2024 winners; Mokyr and Aghion were 2025 winners.

questions.q: Who won Best Actress at the 98th Academy Awards in March 2026?
questions.e: Jessie Buckley won for her role in Hamnet. Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for Sinners.

questions.q: In the Union Budget 2026-27, presented on 1 February 2026, the fiscal deficit target for 2026-27 was set at about what share of GDP?
questions.e: The Budget aimed for a fiscal deficit of 4.3% of GDP for 2026-27, with debt-to-GDP projected at about 55.6%.

questions.q: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta presented the Delhi Budget 2026-27 on 24 March 2026 with a total outlay of about:
questions.e: The 'green' budget had an outlay of ₹1,03,700 crore, with about 21% for green initiatives. It was her second budget as CM.

questions.q: What was the outcome declaration of the India AI Impact Summit held in February 2026 called?
o: New Delhi Declaration on AI Impact
questions.e: The summit ended with the New Delhi Declaration on AI Impact, endorsed by dozens of countries and organisations. Bletchley and Seoul belong to earlier AI summits.

questions.q: The Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2024, announced in September 2026, was given to which veteran actor?
questions.e: Anant Nag was named for the 2024 award, to be presented at the 72nd National Film Awards. Mohanlal, Mithun Chakraborty and Waheeda Rehman were earlier recipients.

questions.q: Who won the men's singles title at Wimbledon 2026?
questions.e: Jannik Sinner won again, successfully defending the title he took in 2025.

questions.q: At the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, India finished at which position in the overall medal table?
questions.e: India won 13 gold, 17 silver and 9 bronze (39 medals) and finished fourth, behind Australia, England and Canada.

questions.q: How many medals in total did India win at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya?
questions.e: India won 21 gold, 27 silver and 37 bronze, 85 in all, and finished fourth. The 2023 Hangzhou record was above 100.

questions.q: Which party won the West Bengal Assembly election, counted on 4 May 2026, and is set to form its first government in the state?
questions.e: The BJP won a large majority, ending the Trinamool Congress's 15-year rule.

questions.q: ISRO's GSLV-F17 launched the EOS-05 satellite on 4 September 2026. What is notable about EOS-05?
o: It is India's first Earth observation satellite meant to work from geosynchronous orbit
It is India's first satellite to orbit the Moon
It is India's first crewed capsule
It is India's first polar weather satellite
questions.e: EOS-05, weighing 2,367 kg, is meant to work from geosynchronous orbit and replaces the capability lost with GSLV-F10 in 2021.

questions.q: Who won the Golden Boot at the FIFA World Cup 2026?
questions.e: Mbappé finished as top scorer with 10 goals.

questions.q: On 21 November 2025 the Centre brought four labour codes into effect. How many existing central labour laws did they replace?
questions.e: The Codes on Wages, Industrial Relations, Social Security, and Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions replaced 29 central laws.

questions.q: Who won the open FIDE Candidates Tournament 2026 held in Cyprus in April 2026, earning a title match against D. Gukesh?
questions.e: Javokhir Sindarov of Uzbekistan won the tournament with 10 points out of 14, earning the title match against Gukesh.

questions.q: In January 2026, who was elected unopposed as the BJP national president, succeeding J. P. Nadda?
questions.e: Nitin Nabin, a five-time Bihar MLA aged 45, became the party's youngest national president.

questions.q: The Union Budget 2026-27 proposed public capital expenditure of about how much?
questions.e: Capital expenditure was set at about ₹12.2 lakh crore for 2026-27. The ₹11.2 lakh crore figure is close to the previous year's allocation.

questions.q: The final of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026, in which India beat New Zealand by 96 runs on 8 March 2026, was played at which ground?
questions.e: The final was at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad, where India made 255/5 and bowled New Zealand out for 159.

questions.q: Which team lost to Spain in the final of the FIFA World Cup 2026 on 19 July 2026?
questions.e: Spain beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time at the New York New Jersey Stadium.

questions.q: At the 2026 Commonwealth Games, India's 39 medals were matched by which team, which finished fifth with more bronze but fewer silver medals?
questions.e: Scotland also won 39 medals (13 gold, 9 silver, 17 bronze). India took fourth on the strength of its 17 silvers.

questions.q: Which Indian author's novel The Loneliness of Sonia and Sunny was on the 2025 Booker shortlist but lost to the winner?
questions.e: Kiran Desai, a former Booker winner, was the main rival to David Szalay, who won for Flesh.

questions.q: Who was the runner-up to Jannik Sinner in the Wimbledon 2026 men's singles final?
questions.e: Sinner beat Alexander Zverev in four sets for the title.

questions.q: PSLV-C62, launched on 12 January 2026 with DRDO's EOS-N1 as the main payload, failed because of a problem in which stage?
questions.e: Trouble began after ignition of the third stage, the same stage involved in the PSLV-C61 failure of 2025.

questions.q: After India's chairship and the 18th summit in New Delhi in September 2026, which country is due to host the next BRICS summit in 2027?
questions.e: China is to host the 2027 summit, after India's chair year and the New Delhi Declaration.

questions.q: Under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025, what is the Centre-State funding ratio for most States?
questions.e: Most States share the cost 60:40 with the Centre. North-Eastern and Himalayan States get 90:10.

questions.q: Along with raising the repo rate on 7 October 2026, the RBI MPC changed its policy stance to:
questions.e: On 7 October 2026 the stance moved from neutral to calibrated tightening, along with a rise in the repo rate.
